orbit_woman: Cinematic live-action fashion film, natural skin texture, restrained color grading, realistic cloth physics. An adult woman, about 28 years old, stands in a circular stone courtyard. She wears a deep emerald coat and a cream silk scarf. Archways and foreground columns establish clear depth. Warm late-afternoon side light; stable exposure and soft moving highlights. The camera makes a small, smooth 15-degree clockwise arc; keep her face centered. Do not attempt a full circle in one second. Initial state: The woman faces the camera, both feet planted; hair tied loosely; scarf rests on her right shoulder. One uninterrupted shot, about 1 seconds. From 0 to 0.35 seconds: Start from a frontal three-quarter view. The camera begins its arc, a near column slides slowly across the background. From 0.35 to 1 seconds: Continue the arc smoothly. She turns her eyes toward the lens and the scarf lifts slightly, then begins to settle. Same face and outfit throughout. <AUDCAP>Quiet courtyard air and a soft breeze. A brief silk rustle; no dialogue or music.<ENDAUDCAP>
strange_tram: Surreal retrofuturist dark comedy, 1970s science-fiction cinema, tactile practical creature effects, worn brass, painted miniatures, muted teal and amber, subtle film grain. A rain-wet tram stop in an imaginary industrial city. An original pear-shaped, blue-skinned commuter with tiny spectacles and a tan raincoat waits beside a brass ticket machine. He has two arms and two legs. Overcast daylight mixed with warm tungsten light in the ticket machine. A short, slow push-in, without changing the view angle. Initial state: The commuter holds one paper ticket. The ticket slot is shut. Steam drifts behind the stop. One uninterrupted shot, about 1 seconds. From 0 to 0.4 seconds: The brass ticket slot clicks open. The commuter freezes and raises one eyebrow. From 0.4 to 1 seconds: A small mechanical tongue briefly taps the edge of his ticket, then retracts. The commuter blinks in deadpan disbelief. <AUDCAP>One dry metallic click over quiet rain. A soft rubbery squeak and a tiny bell; no speech.<ENDAUDCAP>
mechanical_bloom: Tactile miniature science-fiction film, stop-motion-inspired creature design with smooth motion, copper mechanisms and translucent botanical tissue, detailed macro photography. An original small flower made of copper ribs and translucent pale-blue petals grows from a cracked ceramic pot on a workbench. The background is an unfocused greenhouse. Soft green backlight through glass with a warm practical lamp on the workbench. A tiny sideways camera slide creating gentle foreground parallax. Initial state: One closed flower bud; a drop of water hangs from a copper leaf. One uninterrupted shot, about 1 seconds. From 0 to 0.5 seconds: The bud quivers and the first pair of petals separates. From 0.5 to 1 seconds: The petals open a little farther and release one small puff of glowing pollen. The pot and bench stay fixed. <AUDCAP>A quiet metallic tick. A soft pneumatic puff and a delicate chime; no voice.<ENDAUDCAP>
room_assembly: Photorealistic Scandinavian furniture commercial, clean geometric composition, natural materials, restrained palette. Initial state: One unbranded flat-pack cardboard box in the center of the room. No other furniture. One uninterrupted shot, about 1 seconds. From 0 to 0.3 seconds: The sealed cardboard box begins to tremble gently. From 0.3 to 1 seconds: Its top flaps pop open and the first pair of wooden bed rails rises a short distance above the box. The rest stays packed. <AUDCAP>A low brief cardboard rattle. A soft pop and two wooden clacks. The room is otherwise quiet.<ENDAUDCAP>

An adult woman, about 28 years old, stands in a circular stone courtyard. She wears a deep emerald coat and a cream silk scarf. Archways and foreground columns establish clear depth. Warm late-afternoon side light; stable exposure and soft moving highlights. The camera performs a smooth approximately 160-degree clockwise orbit from a front three-quarter view to a rear three-quarter view. Keep the woman centered at the same scale; archways pass with strong parallax. Initial state: The woman faces the camera, both feet planted; hair tied loosely; scarf rests on her right shoulder. One uninterrupted shot, about 5 seconds. From 0 to 1 seconds: Establish her face and emerald coat. The camera starts moving; a foreground column passes along the edge. From 1 to 3.6 seconds: The camera continues around her right side. She slowly turns her head to follow the lens, while a single gust pulls her scarf outward. Her body remains planted. From 3.6 to 5 seconds: Arrive at the rear three-quarter view. The scarf settles onto her shoulder and the camera eases to a stop; preserve her silhouette and clothing. <AUDCAP>Soft courtyard ambience. One gentle gust, silk fluttering, distant birds.
